scripts.title: Echo hub
scripts.features:
This script is designed for survival automation, combat enhancement, resource farming, and quality-of-life improvements in the horror survival game where players build camps, gather wood/fuel/food, defend against night invasions (Deer, Owl, Cultists, Ram, etc.), rescue kids to shorten the 99-night goal, and explore biomes like volcano and snow.
Features are categorized for clarity:
Combat & Defense

Kill Aura: Automatically damages/kills nearby enemies (Deer, Cultists, Wolves, Bears, Owl, Ram, etc.) within adjustable range.
Chop Aura: Auto-chops trees/wood sources in range for infinite fuel/wood supply.
Auto Stun Deer/Owl: Automatically stuns pursuing entities like The Deer or The Owl using flashlight or other mechanics.
God Mode: Invincibility against all damage, invasions, and environmental hazards (e.g., corruption, cold).
Auto Tame Animals: Instantly recruit wolves, mammoths, etc., via Taming Flute for camp defense.

Farming & Automation

Auto Farm Resources: Gathers wood, fuel (coal, gasoline, chairs), food, medicine, diamonds, and junk automatically.
Bring Items: Teleports specified items (fuel, food, medkits, equipment, chests) directly to camp.
Auto Plant Saplings: Replants trees automatically for sustainable wood and defensive perimeters.
Auto Cook Food: Cooks all food at crock pot for hunger management.
Auto Feed: Maintains hunger/thirst without manual input.
Auto Scrap Items: Sells junk for diamonds automatically.
Auto Rescue Kids: Teleports to and rescues missing children to reduce night count.

Base & Progression

Auto Upgrade Campfire/Crafting Bench: Instantly maxes campfire levels and bench tiers (for compass, sundial, farm plots, lightning rod).
Auto Build Defenses: Places log walls, bear traps, laser fences, barbed wire, lava mines around camp.
Auto Days/Nights: Advances day-night cycle or skips to night 99 instantly.
Infinite Diamonds: Generates diamonds for class rerolls/upgrades (e.g., Scavenger class).

Movement & Utility

Fly / No Clip: Free flight and wall-passing for fast exploration (volcano/snow biomes).
Speed Hack: Adjustable walkspeed/jumppower for quick escapes.
Teleport Menu: Instant TP to campfire, kids, trader (Rabbit's Foot), stronghold, safe zone, random trees/chests, map scan.
Instant Interact: Bypasses delays on crafting, trading, looting.

Visuals & ESP

ESP: Highlights enemies (Deer, Owl, Cultists), players, items (wood, fuel, chests), kids, animals through walls.
Fullbright / No Fog: Removes darkness/fog for perfect night vision; disables corruption visuals.
Vibrant Colors / Disable Fog: Enhances graphics for better spotting resources/enemies.
Map Scanner: Reveals full map, biomes, loot locations.

Misc

Anti-AFK: Prevents kick for inactivity during auto-farms.
Server Crash Protection: Stabilizes exploits in large servers (up to 25 players).
GUI Toggle: Clean, keyless UI with sliders for ranges (e.g., aura radius) and toggles.
Hard Mode Bypass: Auto-handles corruption rifts, meter, and debuffs.
